## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Sòng-period Esoteric *dhāraṇī* scripture by **Fǎxián** ([法賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%B3%A2), the Sòng Yìjīngyuàn translator also known as Tiānxīzāi) on a *dhāraṇī* whose recitation produces "limitless merit" (*wúliàng gōngdé*).

**Abstract**

A short *dhāraṇī*-recitation scripture in the genre of *gōngdé* ("merit-producing") *dhāraṇī* texts that became popular in the Sòng-period devotional environment. The translation dates from Fǎxián's career at the Sòng Yìjīngyuàn (987–1001).
